anchors.5: Clear and specific to the stated brief

dimension_guidance.hook_appeal: Does the opening give this stated reader a specific reason to continue? HUMAN only.
dimension_guidance.reader_resonance: Does it address supplied audience needs without inventing customer facts? HUMAN only.
dimension_guidance.brand_tone: Does it match the supplied tone and brand facts? HUMAN only.
dimension_guidance.information_clarity: Can the reader understand the offered next step? Rule score tests format only; HUMAN evaluates meaning.
dimension_guidance.cta_clarity: Is the requested action concrete and appropriate? Rule score checks presence only.
dimension_guidance.platform_native: Does the short conversational format suit Threads? Rule score checks length/schema only.
dimension_guidance.creativity: Is the framing distinct without unsupported novelty claims? HUMAN only.
dimension_guidance.claim_safety: Are claims grounded in supplied evidence? Rule score is a lexical screen, never professional certification.
